def hidden_rule_fn(state):
    rows = len(state)
    cols = len(state[0])
    next_state = [[0] * cols for _ in range(rows)]
    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(cols):
            if r % 2 == 0:  # even row, E/W neighborhood
                next_state[r][c] = state[r][(c + 1) % cols]
            else:  # odd row, N/S neighborhood
                next_state[r][c] = state[(r + 1) % rows][c]
    return next_state
